amenities.create:
CREATE TABLE amenities (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(50), 
	icon VARCHAR(100), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (name)
)

bed_options.create:
CREATE TABLE bed_options (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(50), 
	icon VARCHAR(200), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

rooms.create:
CREATE TABLE rooms (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(100), 
	description TEXT, 
	max_guests INTEGER, 
	number_of_rooms INTEGER, 
	title_dop VARCHAR(100), 
	floor INTEGER, 
	area INTEGER, 
	calendar_token VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_rooms_calendar_token ON rooms (calendar_token)

site_info.create:
CREATE TABLE site_info (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	main_photo VARCHAR(200), 
	main_description TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

users.create:
CREATE TABLE users (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(255), 
	name VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	hashed_password VARCHAR(255), 
	is_active BOOLEAN, 
	is_superuser BOOLEAN, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_email ON users (email)

bookings.create:
CREATE TABLE bookings (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	room_id INTEGER, 
	check_in_date DATE, 
	check_out_date DATE, 
	number_of_guests INTEGER, 
	price FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	guest_name VARCHAR(100), 
	guest_phone VARCHAR(20), 
	guest_comment TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(room_id) REFERENCES rooms (id)
)

calendar_sync_sources.create:
CREATE TABLE calendar_sync_sources (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	room_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	url TEXT NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN, 
	last_synced_at DATETIME, 
	last_error TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(room_id) REFERENCES rooms (id)
)

courtyard_photos.create:
CREATE TABLE courtyard_photos (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	url VARCHAR(200), 
	category VARCHAR(30), 
	sort_order INTEGER, 
	site_info_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(site_info_id) REFERENCES site_info (id)
)

faqs.create:
CREATE TABLE faqs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	question TEXT, 
	answer TEXT, 
	site_info_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(site_info_id) REFERENCES site_info (id)
)

price_periods.create:
CREATE TABLE price_periods (
	number_of_guests INTEGER, 
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	start_date DATE, 
	end_date DATE, 
	price INTEGER, 
	room_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(room_id) REFERENCES rooms (id)
)

room_amenities.create:
CREATE TABLE room_amenities (
	room_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	amenity_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (room_id, amenity_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(room_id) REFERENCES rooms (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(amenity_id) REFERENCES amenities (id)
)

room_bed_options.create:
CREATE TABLE room_bed_options (
	room_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	bed_option_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (room_id, bed_option_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(room_id) REFERENCES rooms (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(bed_option_id) REFERENCES bed_options (id)
)

room_photos.create:
CREATE TABLE room_photos (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	url VARCHAR(200), 
	is_main BOOLEAN, 
	sort_order INTEGER, 
	room_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(room_id) REFERENCES rooms (id)
)

site_events.create:
CREATE TABLE site_events (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(50), 
	room_id INTEGER, 
	path VARCHAR(300), 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(room_id) REFERENCES rooms (id)
)

testimonial_images.create:
CREATE TABLE testimonial_images (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	url VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER, 
	site_info_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(site_info_id) REFERENCES site_info (id)
)

testimonials.create:
CREATE TABLE testimonials (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	author_name VARCHAR(100), 
	author_icon_url VARCHAR(200), 
	comment TEXT, 
	site_info_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(site_info_id) REFERENCES site_info (id)
)

calendar_sync_events.create:
CREATE TABLE calendar_sync_events (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	room_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	uid VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	summary VARCHAR(300), 
	start_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	end_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	imported_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_id) REFERENCES calendar_sync_sources (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(room_id) REFERENCES rooms (id)
)
